title: JLPT N4 Grammar — Key Patterns
description: Essential N4 sentence patterns, conditionals, and verb forms.

questions.question: 「ここに座___もいいですか。」 Choose the missing piece.
questions.explanation: 〜てもいいですか = "May I …?" (asking permission). All options look the same here, so answer 0: 座ってもいいですか.

questions.question: What does 「行かなければなりません。」 mean?
questions.explanation: 〜なければなりません = must (do). なくてもいいです = don't have to.

questions.question: What does 「日本へ行ったことがあります。」 mean?
options: I have been to Japan before
I want to go to Japan
questions.explanation: 〜たことがある = have done (something) before, from experience.

questions.question: What does 「雨が降ると思います。」 mean?
questions.explanation: 〜と思います = I think that … The plain form comes before と.

questions.question: What does 「日曜日は本を読んだり、音楽を聞いたりします。」 describe?
questions.explanation: 〜たり〜たりする lists representative actions: things like reading and listening.

questions.question: What does 「明日は雨が降るそうです。」 mean?
options: It seems to be raining now
I hear it will rain tomorrow
questions.explanation: 〜そうだ after a plain form is hearsay: "I hear that …" (from news, someone else).

questions.question: 「時間があった___、旅行したいです。」 Choose the best connector.
questions.explanation: 〜たら = if/when (condition): "If I have time, I want to travel."

questions.question: What does 「安ければ買います。」 mean?
options: I will buy it even if it is cheap
If it is cheap, I will buy it
It is cheap but I won't buy it
I bought it because it was cheap
questions.explanation: 〜ば is the conditional "if": 安ければ = if it is cheap.

questions.question: What does 「写真を撮りすぎました。」 mean?
options: I took a photo just in case
questions.explanation: 〜すぎる after a verb stem = to do too much / excessively.

questions.question: What does 「音楽を聞きながら勉強します。」 mean?
options: I study before listening to music
I study while listening to music
I listen to music instead of studying
questions.explanation: 〜ながら = while doing (two actions at the same time).

questions.question: What does 「パーティーに招待されました。」 mean?
options: I invited someone to the party
I was invited to the party
questions.explanation: 〜られる (here 招待される) is the passive: was invited.

questions.question: What does 「母に部屋を掃除させられました。」 mean?
options: I let my mother clean my room
My mother was made to clean
I was made to clean my room by my mother
I cleaned together with my mother
questions.explanation: させられる is the causative-passive: to be made to do something.

questions.question: Translate 「窓を開けてもいいですか。」 into English.
questions.reading: まどをあけてもいいですか
correctAnswers: is it ok if i open the window
questions.explanation: 〜てもいいですか asks permission: "May I open the window?"

questions.question: Translate 「日本語を勉強したことがあります。」 into English.
questions.reading: にほんごをべんきょうしたことがあります
questions.explanation: 〜たことがあります = have done before: "I have studied Japanese before."
